sourceCommands: node scripts/wrangler-oauth.mjs d1 execute ks2-mastery-db --remote --json --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS hero_state_rows FROM child_game_state WHERE system_id='hero-mode';"
node scripts/wrangler-oauth.mjs d1 execute ks2-mastery-db --remote --json --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS hero_event_rows FROM event_log WHERE system_id='hero-mode';"
node scripts/wrangler-oauth.mjs d1 execute ks2-mastery-db --remote --json --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS adult_accounts FROM adult_accounts;"

node scripts/wrangler-oauth.mjs d1 execute ks2-mastery-db --remote --json --command "SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 'demo' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS real_accounts, SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 'demo' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS demo_accounts FROM adult_accounts;"
node scripts/wrangler-oauth.mjs d1 execute ks2-mastery-db --remote --json --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS learner_memberships FROM account_learner_memberships;"

node scripts/wrangler-oauth.mjs d1 execute ks2-mastery-db --remote --json --command "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT learner_id) AS ready_subject_learners FROM child_game_state WHERE system_id IN ('spelling','grammar','punctuation');"

node scripts/wrangler-oauth.mjs d1 execute ks2-mastery-db --remote --json --command "SELECT system_id AS subject, COUNT(DISTINCT learner_id) AS learners FROM child_game_state WHERE system_id IN ('spelling','grammar','punctuation') GROUP BY system_id ORDER BY system_id;"

notes: Cloudflare secret list exposes names only, not values.
HERO_INTERNAL_ACCOUNTS count remains unknown because the value is write-only.
No rollout percent, rollout salt, excluded-account, external-account, or emergency-off secret name was present.

productionBoundarySmoke.scope: Proves a new demo/non-cohort production session does not receive Hero while global flags are off. It does not prove allowlisted cohort flow.

contractStatus.reason: The selected operational posture is HOLD, but pA7's valid-hold contract is not complete because the internal allowlist size is unknown, production release owners/support cadence are not fully evidenced, known-account smoke did not pass, and emergency-off rollback was not rehearsed.

decision.reason: Live production was inspected without widening. The rollout-bucket path is 0 percent because rollout percent/salt are absent, but total exposure remains unknown while HERO_INTERNAL_ACCOUNTS is present and write-only. This blocks contract-complete A7 closure as well as any normalisation or widening.

requiredBeforeNormaliseOrWiden: Record or rotate HERO_INTERNAL_ACCOUNTS to a known reviewed value without losing any intended cohort account.
Add HERO_EXCLUDED_ACCOUNTS or an equivalent opt-out/exclusion control before family exposure.
Run the A7 known-account production smoke across read model, start-task, subject completion, claim, coins, Camp, excluded account, and non-cohort command denial.
Rehearse HERO_EMERGENCY_DISABLED=true or equivalent production rollback after the intended exposure state is reached.
Record support zeroes or issues with the named support owner and daily review owner.
Run the schema-accurate pA6 metrics extractor against live exported Hero rows once any Hero rows exist.
